caption:
A saved reel: a guy finds families owed insurance money and keeps a big cut. 💸

In Australia you don't need a middle-man. It's free:
1. Search your name and your family's on moneysmart.gov.au (unclaimed money)
2. Check for lost super through myGov

Takes five minutes.

Found in my own saved reels and sorted by SaveSort. Sort yours free, link in bio.
